core_philosophy: Creator Identity Operating System — The Identity Layer of the ANCR Ecosystem. Minimal, elegant, Apple-quality UI. NOT a social profile.

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
IDs, numbers, data points, and status labels must use JetBrains Mono.
Left-align text globally unless specifically centering a hero statement.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing, asymmetry, and optical alignment. The UI must feel like an OS, not a website.

surfaces.premium_glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
surfaces.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for premium feel

cinematic_motion.glass_shimmer: mask-image dynamic gradients on hover for premium edge-lighting

micro_interactions: Status dots must pulse softly (live connection feel).
Borders of glass cards slightly illuminate based on mouse proximity.
Ecosystem connections draw glowing lines between modules on hover.

ecosystem_status_panel.design: Horizontal premium glass pill. Contains dots for ANCRA, ANCRLAB, ANCRSync, INHEIRA, Vaulta, Passport, ANCRLaunch.
ecosystem_status_panel.active_state: Glowing electric blue dot + JetBrains Mono label.

creator_passport.elements: JetBrains Mono for Passport ID, Gradient Flow for verified badge, high-res portrait, holographic overlay effect.

aia_intelligence_panel.layout: Right-aligned vertical drawer or bottom bento grid item.
aia_intelligence_panel.style: Subtle Violet/Orange background glow behind the card to indicate AI presence.
aia_intelligence_panel.data: Mocked suggestions for collaborations, skill leveling, and ecosystem matching.

data_visualization.reputation_score: Donut chart using Primary (Blue) to Secondary (Violet) gradient stroke.
data_visualization.timeline: Vertical left-aligned timeline with JetBrains Mono timestamps.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract electric blue and orange lighting for cinematic OS background
Deep dark abstract light rings for auth page

creator_portraits.description: Cinematic portrait of creator looking off camera

portfolio_work.description: Close up of DJ mixer / studio gear

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, and JetBrains Mono fonts via CDN/Google Fonts immediately.
Build a fixed Dashboard header titled 'Ecosystem Status' showing live dots for: ANCRA, ANCRLAB, ANCRSync, INHEIRA, Vaulta, Passport, ANCRLaunch.
Ensure UI is strictly dark mode (Obsidian #050505) with glassmorphism overlays.
Use framer-motion for cinematic page transitions and micro-interactions.
Data points like ANCRID Number, Portfolio Score, and Passport ID must use JetBrains Mono.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the application.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
